name: Grade 8 IIT Summative: Arduino Basics
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 8 Arduino vocabulary table.

words.definition: A board and tool used for physical computing.
words.example: The Arduino ran the sketch that blinked the LED.

words.definition: A kit used to learn Arduino-style electronics.
words.example: The Freenove kit provided the breadboard, wires, resistor, and LED.

words.definition: A small computer board that controls electronics.
words.example: The microcontroller read the button input and controlled the LED.

words.definition: A path that electricity can follow.
words.example: The circuit connected power, ground, a resistor, and an LED.

words.definition: A board used to build circuits without soldering.
words.example: The student placed the resistor and LED on the breadboard before testing.

words.definition: A connection point on a board.
words.example: The LED wire was connected to digital pin 13.

words.definition: Electricity used to run a circuit.
words.example: The power wire carried electricity from the board to the circuit.

words.definition: The return path for electricity in a circuit.
words.example: The ground wire completed the circuit back to the Arduino.

words.definition: A part that limits electric current.
words.example: The resistor protected the LED from too much current.

words.definition: An Arduino output light controlled by a digital pin.
words.example: The LED turned on when the output pin was HIGH.
